edges.label: Employs Knuth; Professor of Physics since 2023, on the faculty since 2005
edges.note: The UAlbany Department of Physics faculty page lists Knuth's appointments as Assistant Professor 2005-2009, Associate Professor 2009-2023, Professor 2023-present, immediately following four years as a GS-14 Research Scientist in the Intelligent Systems Division at NASA Ames (2001-2005). The same page records him as Editor-in-Chief of Entropy (MDPI) since 2012, which is the journal that published the 2019 Nimitz kinematics paper. This is the primary reason the institution is on the board: it is the salaried academic post from which the peer-reviewed UAP kinematics and field-instrumentation literature was produced.
